## Decision notes (verification.yaml)

| Item | Category | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `cohort.exclusion` | method_decision | Dialysis/transplant (kidney failure with replacement therapy) excluded from the cohort for this kit (provisional; V-22a open question). |
| `eGFR` | method_decision | eGFR is taken from the source measurement (not recomputed); the equation (2021 CKD-EPI per KDIGO 2024) must be checked against the CDR (V-22a, V-25). |
| `phenotype.case_index_rule` | method_decision | Index = the date chronicity is first satisfied (second qualifying value >=90 days after the first). |
| `phenotype.case_rule` | documentation_derived | V-22a. KDIGO 2024 (kdigo_ckd_2024, text extracted from the official PDF): abnormalities of kidney structure or function present for a minimum of 3 months; decreased GFR <60 ml/min per 1.73 m2 or albuminuria ACR >=30 mg/g. Operationalized as >=2 qualifying values spanning >=90 days (min_span), or >=2 CKD diagnoses on distinct days (eMERGE-style, nadkarni_2014_emerge_ckd). All thresholds and counts provisional pending reviewer verification. |
| `phenotype.control_rule` | documentation_derived | V-22b. Controls need repeated normal kidney function: >=2 eGFR values >=60 on distinct days, no eGFR <60, no ACR >=30 mg/g, and no CKD diagnosis (provisional). |
| `phenotype.control_sampling` | method_decision | ADR-002 matched sampling on visit type and calendar year, 2 per case (provisional, V-20). |
| `phenotype.label_defining_concepts` | documentation_derived | FR-135: CKD diagnoses, creatinine/eGFR, urine albumin/protein; plus AKI (used to exclude transient decreases). |
| `phenotype.min_observation_history` | method_decision | 365 days of history (provisional; V-11 observation periods pending). |
| `prohibited` | method_decision | V-24 review in docs/features.md. |
| `temporal_policy.exclude_index_encounter` | method_decision | Exclude the confirming encounter (V-20 option C). |
| `temporal_policy.same_day` | method_decision | Exclude the index day: the chronicity-confirming creatinine/eGFR is usually drawn with a basic metabolic panel. |
